justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/common/BitMatrix.java` (537 lines, 29 public methods) and `core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/common/BitMatrixTestCase.java`. Although the class is broad, its methods are cohesive around one abstraction and one backing state (`width`, `height`, `rowSize`, `bits`): bit access/mutation, row copy, rotation, rectangle/bit queries, parsing, and string rendering. I did not find clearly separate responsibilities or a low-cohesion split that would justify insufficient modularization.
